svg.title: Baghdad Airport traction supply single-line drawing
svg.desc: Planning layout of both positive conductor tracks and normally open ties, followed by a vehicle and rail-return circuit detail.
svg.text: Baghdad Airport | Traction power single line
12 km • 30 rectifier sites • 116 outgoing DC breakers • 58 normally open ties
Squares are closed outgoing breakers. Open blades are track ties. Repeated site labels continue the preceding row.
Local supply and return | S01 to the first track tie
One end-site circuit is expanded below. Each terminal feeds two outgoing circuits. Each interior site feeds four.
Negative return bonds and fault-current path require supplier design.
Outage operation, access and quotation holds
A failed source divides the restored sections at its chainage. Adjacent healthy sites may feed toward the isolated bus.
Require selective trips, proof of isolation and a route-specific switching interlock to prevent backfeed through ties or shoes.
Before access or evacuation, inhibit traction, prove the work zone dead and establish its approved bonding and earthing state.
Emergency lighting, accessible walkways, rescue and re-energisation authority require witnessed procedures.
Quote against 13.58 MW peak DC per site and a 1.35 kV collector floor.
Return utility fault levels, transformer and rectifier duty, breaker ratings and settings, switching times and tie ratings.
Provide hot conductor and rail impedance, bond and earth layout, touch-voltage limits, cooling and cable schedules.
Preliminary supplier enquiry • Installation, protection coordination and operating authority require engineering review.
